manifest.name: @unknowssq/better-experience
manifest.description: One-click prompt optimization and settings for DeepSeek Harness.
manifest.author: UnknowSSQ

bundle.text:
- insert:
    - id: better-experience
      name: '@unknowssq/better-experience'
      config: { enabled: true }

readme.text:
English | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

A DeepSeek Harness plugin that rewrites the prompt you are about to send — Standard or Professional, with scene-aware routing — and keeps your account balance and time-of-use pricing in view at the sidebar foot.

> **Community plugin.** Independently maintained; not built, reviewed, or supported by DeepSeek. A plugin runs with the host's own permissions, so read the source before installing it into a profile that holds real data.

| | |
|---|---|
| Package | `@unknowssq/better-experience` — MIT; the first npm release is pending |
| Surface | Web client (`dsh.client.platform: "web"`): the `web` profile and the Desktop app |
| Requires | dsh `>=0.2.1-rc.5` (`engines.dsh`) |
| Install | `dsh plugin --profile web add "@unknowssq/better-experience@link:<path to this checkout>"` |
| Exposes | one host command `/be-optimize`, two HTTP routes, five client slots |

In the package: `index.js` holds the Config schema and the command; `client.js` holds all five slot contributions as a single `window.__ModuleLoader__` bundle. Verified on dsh `0.2.1-rc.5` (Windows), last checked 2026-10-31.

- [Requirements](#requirements)
- [Installation](#installation)
- [Quick start](#quick-start)

- **One-click rewrite** — the sparkle button left of Send (`conversation.input.activity`) rewrites the current draft in place: only the clean prompt reaches your editor, and nothing else is appended to it.
- **Manual only** — nothing rewrites the draft in the background and nothing delays a send. The draft changes only when you press the button; Enter always submits exactly what is in the composer.
- **Two fixed modes** — Standard keeps the rewrite concise while clarifying the request; Professional models task complexity and adds execution and acceptance detail when needed.
- **Scene routing** — `professional` either classifies the scene itself (`auto`) or is pinned to one of eight scenes (`coding`, `writing`, `research`, `data`, `creative`, `business`, `agent`, `general`). `coding` additionally enables the implementation sub-scene rules.
- **Output language** — follow the draft's language, or pin Chinese / English.

- **The button becomes undo** — right after a rewrite the same button switches to an undo icon. One click puts the pre-optimization draft back verbatim, and the sparkle returns.
- **A hand edit retires the slot** — as soon as you change the draft yourself, the undo state is dropped, so the button can never restore text over edits it did not make.
- **Typing keys stay the host's** — the plugin registers no `Ctrl+Z` / `Ctrl+Y` binding. Undo and redo inside the composer keep the host editor's own behaviour.

- **Balance and price card** — mounted at `sidebar.footer.action`: current balance, a peak / off-peak chip counting down to the next switch, and the cache-hit input price for Flash and V4 Pro at that period. It polls every 60 s, refreshes on focus or tab return, keeps the last snapshot as *stale* instead of flashing an error, and collapses to a wallet icon with a status dot in the rail.
- **Draft meter** — mounted at `conversation.input.left`: estimated tokens for the live draft, their cost at the current period, and three dots that check goal / constraints / acceptance locally. No tokenizer, no model call, no network.
- **Project templates** — read from `.agents/prompts/*.md`; typing `/tpl:<name>` alone and pressing Enter inserts the skeleton without sending, and a pinned template is passed to the optimizer as a structural reference.

| Requirement | Detail |
|---|---|
| dsh | `>=0.2.1-rc.5` (`engines.dsh` in `package.json`) |
| Client bundle | The Web client (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app`). A host-only profile loads the plugin but has no UI. |
| Default model | `/be-optimize` calls the currently selected model through `ctx.llm`; with no selection it answers 「没有可用模型，请先配置模型」. |
| Optional services | `fs` and `webServer`. Both are probed, not injected — without them the template route is simply not registered. |
| Node / pnpm | Whatever the DSH runtime ships. The plugin itself has one runtime dependency, `@deepseek-ai/schemastery`. |

The package is named `@unknowssq/better-experience` and is prepared for npm, but `0.1.0` is not on the registry yet, so the verified install today is a linked checkout. Both forms are covered below: once `0.1.0` is published, `add` takes the bare package name and the checkout is only needed when you edit the source.

Once `0.1.0` is on the registry this is the whole install:

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add @unknowssq/better-experience
dsh --profile web --no-open
```

`dsh plugin add` writes both halves in one step: `dependencies` receives the package, and `dsh.profile.bundles` receives its name. Start the profile **without** `--patch` — see [How a profile loads this plugin](#how-a-profile-loads-this-plugin).

To run the code you are editing instead of the published version:

```powershell
cd <path to this checkout>
pnpm install
dsh plugin --profile web add "@unknowssq/better-experience@link:<path to this checkout>"
dsh --profile web --no-open

The Desktop app owns its profile: `dsh --profile desktop --dump-config` exits with `error: profile "desktop" is managed exclusively by the Electron application`, so there is no CLI start or inspect path. The supported route is the app's own plugin manager. On rc.5 the CLI can still perform the install itself:

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add @unknowssq/better-experience
```
Then **quit the app completely and reopen it**. `bundles` is startup configuration; the in-app plugin refresh only remounts plugins that were already in the roster.

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web list
```

The sidebar should show a **Better Experience** entry, and the composer should show the optimize button and the draft meter. If the host loaded but the UI is missing, the package is not in `bundles` — see the table under [Diagnosing a plugin that does not load](#diagnosing-a-plugin-that-does-not-load).

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web remove @unknowssq/better-experience
```

This removes the dependency and the `bundles` entry. Per-profile settings written into `cordis.patch.yml` are left behind and can be deleted by hand.

1. Install and start the web profile with the commands above.
2. Open the URL printed by DSH, then open **Better Experience** in the sidebar.
3. Type a rough draft, for example 「把这段话改得更自然。」 and press the sparkle button. Only the rewritten prompt is written back into the composer; the button then becomes an undo icon that restores your draft in one click. Nothing is rewritten unless you press that button.
Every field is `volatile()`: changing one takes effect immediately without restarting the host. Values live in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml` under `- id: better-experience`.

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | boolean | `true` | Mounts the optimize button, draft meter, and settings rows. Turning it off unmounts the button, so nothing can rewrite the draft. |
| `template` | string | `""` | Name of a reference template under `.agents/prompts/<name>.md`. Empty disables the few-shot block. |
| `balanceEnabled` | boolean | `true` | Shows the balance and time-of-use price card at the sidebar foot, including the collapsed rail glyph. |
| `mode` | `standard` \| `professional` | `standard` | Task-modeling depth: concise semantic cleanup versus complexity-aware, scene-adaptive structure. |
| `scene` | `auto` \| eight scenes | `auto` | Only used in `professional`; `auto` lets the model classify the scene first. |
| `language` | `auto` \| `zh` \| `en` | `auto` | Output language of the optimized prompt and its metadata. |

Press the sparkle button beside Send. The request is a plain model call with no tools: the draft is wrapped as untrusted `<draft>` data, and the system prompt is composed as

```text
CORE_RULES + MODE_POLICY[mode]
+ SCENE_POLICY[scene] (only when pinned) + CODING_IMPLEMENTATION_POLICY (coding only)
+ LANGUAGE_RULE[language] + template block (when pinned) + OUTPUT_CONTRACT
```

The model must answer with structured JSON (`optimized_prompt`, `intent`, `is_existing_project`, scene routing, `changes`, `assumptions`, `missing_information`). A failed parse gets one repair pass before the text is used verbatim.

After a rewrite, the composer button shows an undo icon instead of the sparkle. One click restores the exact pre-optimization draft and clears the undo state, so the button is the optimize action again. Editing the draft by hand also clears it. The plugin binds no undo or redo keystroke: `Ctrl+Z` inside the composer stays with the host editor, on its own undo history.

Balances come from `remote.account.getBalance` through the host's DeepSeek account service — the plugin has no billing API of its own. Prices are **static reference figures** copied from the official pricing page (2026-09-10 update) and stored in the `BILLING` constant; they are never presented as live billing data. The peak windows are Beijing-time Mon–Fri 09:00–12:00 and 14:00–18:00, everything else is off-peak at half price, and weekends are off-peak for the whole day.

Create a markdown file under `.agents/prompts/`:

```markdown
---
title: 代码评审
scene: coding
vars: lang, focus
---

……
```

`title`, `scene`, and `vars` are optional; an unknown `scene` degrades to `auto`. Templates appear in the 「参考模板」 selector, `/tpl:代码评审` inserts the body, and `insert` / `adopted` counters accumulate in `.agents/prompts/.usage.json`.

| Surface | Name | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Host command | `/be-optimize` | `recordInput: false`. Returns `{ kind: 'success', text }` where `text` is a `{"__be":1,"prompt":…,"meta":…}` envelope; the client applies only `prompt`. |
| HTTP route | `GET /plugins/better-experience/templates` | Template list. Registered only when `webServer` and `fs` both exist. |
| HTTP route | `POST /plugins/better-experience/templates/usage` | Records `insert` / `adopted` counters. Same registration condition. |

| Slot | Id | What it renders |
|---|---|---|
| `conversation.input.activity` | `better-experience-optimize` | Optimize button, which turns into undo after a rewrite |
| `conversation.input.left` | `better-experience-draft-meter` | Token / cost meter and the three-dot check |
| `sidebar.panellist` | `better-experience` | Sidebar entry that opens the panel |
| `sidebar.footer.action` | `better-experience-balance` | Balance card |
| `main` | `better-experience` | Settings panel content |
Host `inject`: `commands`, `llm`, `agentDefaultModel`. Client `inject`: `slots`, `locale`, `remote`, `remote.commands`, `remote.account`, `configForms`, `shortcuts`.

readme.section: How a profile loads this plugin
readme.text: Web and desktop boot the same host code and the same Web client bundle, but they resolve this plugin from different places. Three facts cover almost every "the plugin does not show up" case:

readme.section: How a profile loads this plugin
readme.text:
1. **Only a bundle reaches the browser.** The client script roster is derived from the patch files of the packages listed in `dsh.profile.bundles`; every enabled row whose package declares `dsh.client.platform === 'web'` becomes an injected row (`packages/test-support/client-runtime/src/assembly/bundle-roster.ts`). The profile's own `cordis.patch.yml` is not part of that roster, so an insert living only there loads the host half and leaves the UI empty.
2. **`cordis.patch.yml` overrides, it does not install.** Once the package is in `bundles`, an `- id: better-experience` row in the profile patch applies on top of the bundle's insert. That is where per-profile values live.
3. **`--patch` is a third layer and must not be combined with a bundle install.** It re-inserts the same id, so the composed tree holds two `better-experience` rows and the later, leaner one wins — saved settings look like they bounce back after a click.

readme.section: Diagnosing a plugin that does not load
readme.text:
| Symptom | Cause |
|---|---|
| `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND: Cannot find package '@unknowssq/better-experience'` | `dependencies` has no entry for it |
| `patch: entry "better-experience" not found` | The profile patch overrides an id that no bundle inserts |
| Two `better-experience` rows in `--dump-config`; a selector bounces back after clicking | Bundle install and `--patch` used together |
| Host commands work but the sidebar / settings UI is missing | Package is only in `cordis.patch.yml`, never in `bundles` |
| Desktop UI missing after editing the patch | App not restarted after the `bundles` change |

`client.js` is one bundle: dsh loads third-party clients through `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory(require) })`, where `require()` resolves the host module registry rather than the filesystem. Modularity therefore comes from in-file sections — Constants → Locale → Pure Logic → Hooks → UI Components → Styles → `apply` — with a one-way dependency rule and named CSS constants instead of separate files.

Full partition, dependency rules, and style lifecycle: `docs/plugin-architecture.md`, kept with the development checkout rather than inside the published package.

Design constraints worth knowing before editing:

- **Tokens only.** Every colour comes from host design tokens (`--dsw-alias-*`, `--dsw-radius-*`, `--dsw-shadow-*`); no host selector is restyled, and no colour is hardcoded. One `<style>` element is created in `apply` and removed by its cleanup function.
- **Left-aligned panel.** `.be-settings` uses `margin:0` with `max-width:560px`, so heading, cards, and rows share one left edge.
- **Auto-width footer card.** `.be-foot-card` is `width:fit-content` capped by `max-width:calc(100% - 8px)`; the left column is `flex:0 1 auto; min-width:0` so only the balance ellipsizes, while the price column never shrinks.

```powershell
node --check index.js
node --check client.js
```

There is no build step and no test runner in this package. Source edits are read once at load, so restart the host after changing `index.js` or `client.js`; configuration changes are `volatile()` and apply live.

Use these drafts when reviewing changes to the Standard / Professional policies. Run each in both modes; for conversion checks, feed one mode's output back through the other. Judge by requested deliverable and dominant work, not topic keywords. These are review cases, not automated assertions.

| Case | Draft / conversion | Desired behavior |
|---|---|---|
| Simple request | “把这段话改得更自然。” | Both modes keep a concise prompt; Professional does not add role, workflow, or acceptance sections without a need. |
| Existing project, one fix | “修复设置页切换主题后下拉框仍是浅色的问题。” | Preserve the direct fix request; may direct repository inspection and a focused check, but not multi-phase scaffolding. |
| Explicit constraints | “给报表加导出功能，只改报表模块，不增加依赖，保留现有 CSV 格式。” | All constraints survive both directions of mode conversion and appear once. |
| Multi-task implementation | “增加批量导入、失败重试和导入记录页，并补上必要测试。” | Professional separates the three deliverables with meaningful acceptance checks; no repeated guidance per section. |
| Missing but inspectable detail | “把用户列表加分页。” | Do not ask for page size or API shape up front; direct inspection of existing conventions. |
| Critical ambiguity | “清理生产环境里不需要的数据。” | Ask a focused clarification; never invent deletion scope or authorization. |
| Mixed code and writing | “修复帮助中心 Markdown 页面的代码示例，再润色周边说明。” | Primary: coding; secondary: writing. |
| Research noun, writing outcome | “把我提供的访谈摘录整理成一篇清晰的总结，不要查外部资料。” | Primary: writing; no research secondary. |
Use this draft to review both modes: “优化 dsh 插件的 README.md，专业重构结构，参考官方和社区插件示例，并将项目推送至 GitHub，使插件具备被收录和官方推荐载入的条件。”

| Mode | Expected behavior |
|---|---|
| Standard | Produce a concise rewrite that keeps the stated scope, clarifies the outcome, and adds at most one materially useful detail. Avoid a generic workflow. |
| Professional | Model the multi-part task: inspect the project, verify official criteria against primary sources, distinguish requirements from community conventions, restructure and check the README, then safely push only scoped changes. State unverified criteria and stop if the target is ambiguous, the remote has diverged, or authorization is unavailable. Never imply that documentation guarantees official inclusion. |

Check that the two outputs differ in task-modeling depth while both preserve the requested README work and GitHub push goal. Unsafe or ambiguous Git operations must stop without force-pushing, changing remotes, or discarding unrelated work.

Score each dimension 0–2 (failure / partial / good), tracking primary-scene accuracy separately from secondary precision and recall. For external eligibility tasks, separately score authoritative-source verification, distinction between official rules and convention, and whether unknown criteria are marked unverified. For publishing tasks, score target verification and safe stop behavior. Losing a hard constraint or changing the requested action is a blocking failure regardless of total score.

- **Draft text** is sent to the model you have selected, and the rewritten text is written back into the composer through the host's draft API.
- **Model calls** consume your tokens. Each optimization is one tool-free model call, and nothing else in the plugin calls a model.
- **Templates** are read from `.agents/prompts` in the session workspace and counters are written to `.agents/prompts/.usage.json`.
- **Balance** is read through `remote.account.getBalance`; prices are constants shipped with the plugin.
- **No telemetry**, no analytics endpoint, no network request other than your configured model provider and the account service.

| | |
|---|---|
| Verified | dsh `0.2.1-rc.5`, Windows, 2026-10-31 (web profile and Desktop app) |
| Minimum | `engines.dsh` `>=0.2.1-rc.5` |
| Not verified | Headless / SDK / ACP profiles — the plugin's value is its UI, and the client half does not load there. Host logic is independent of the UI but has not been exercised in those profiles. |
| Breaking changes | This is a `0.x`-era plugin tracking a `0.2.1-rc.x` host; slot names, the command envelope, and the template route are the parts most likely to move. |

Checked against the Harness plugin guide's pre-listing checklist (§6.8–6.9) and the market index generator (`apps/plugin-market-generator/src/packages.ts`, `metadata.ts`). This table records facts about **this** package; it is not a claim of official inclusion.

| Check | Status |
|---|---|
| `dsh.bundle.patch` points at an existing YAML, and its `name` equals the package name | Done — `./cordis.patch.yml`, `@unknowssq/better-experience` |
| `engines.dsh` declares a minimum version | Done — `>=0.2.1-rc.5` |
| A clean profile can install, start, and remove the plugin | Done for `web` and `desktop` — see [Installation](#installation) |
| No `postinstall` or binary download | Done — the package declares no `scripts` |
| README covers install commands, permissions, and uninstall | Done — [Installation](#installation), [Permissions and data](#permissions-and-data) |
| README shows a screenshot | **Missing** — no screenshot is committed |
| License is explicit | Done — MIT, `LICENSE` plus `"license": "MIT"` |
| The package can enter a generated market index | Done — no `private` flag; `dependencies`, `engines`, `exports`, and `files` are present |
| The release is on the npm registry | **Pending** — `npm publish --dry-run` packs 10 files cleanly; the publish itself needs registry credentials |
| The repository carries the `dsh-plugin` topic | Done — `github.com/UnknowSSQ/dsh-plugin` |
| The name follows the `dsh-` prefix convention | **Not follo

Market display metadata is read without evaluating the package: `title` and `description` come from `locale/en.json` (`meta.title`, `meta.description`) through the `exports` map, the icon resolves through `exports["./icon"]`, and `author`, `homepage`, `repository`, and `keywords` are copied from `package.json`. All of those are present today.

1. Keep the single-file client constraint — do not split `client.js` into separate modules.
2. Register through slots and services, never by restyling or querying host markup beyond the documented composer hooks.
3. Run `node --check index.js; node --check client.js` before opening a PR, and re-run both locally in a profile.
4. For policy changes, re-run the review cases above and report scene accuracy separately from constraint preservation.
5. New UI must use host design tokens and the existing `.be-*` markup vocabulary; no new colour literals.

一个 DeepSeek Harness 插件：在你按下发送之前重写草稿——支持标准与专业两档、按场景路由——并在侧边栏底部常驻账户余额与分时价格。

> **社区插件。** 独立维护，非 DeepSeek 构建、审核或支持。插件与宿主同权限运行，请在装入持有真实数据的 profile 之前自行阅读源码。

| | |
|---|---|
| 包 | `@unknowssq/better-experience` — MIT；首个 npm 版本待发布 |
| 适用界面 | Web 客户端（`dsh.client.platform: "web"`）：`web` profile 与桌面应用 |
| 版本要求 | dsh `>=0.2.1-rc.5`（`engines.dsh`） |
| 安装 | `dsh plugin --profile web add "@unknowssq/better-experience@link:<本检出的路径>"` |
| 对外暴露 | 一个 host 命令 `/be-optimize`、两条 HTTP 路由、五个客户端 slot |
包内结构：`index.js` 提供 Config schema 与命令；`client.js` 以单个 `window.__ModuleLoader__` bundle 的形式提供全部五个 slot 贡献。已验证于 dsh `0.2.1-rc.5`（Windows），最后核对日期 2026-10-31。

**提示词优化**

- **一键重写** — 发送按钮左侧的星标按钮（`conversation.input.activity`）就地重写当前草稿：只有干净的提示词被写回输入栏，不会额外附加任何内容。
- **仅手动触发** — 插件不会在后台改写草稿，也不会在发送前插入任何步骤：只有你按下按钮时草稿才会变，Enter 始终原样提交输入栏里的内容。
- **两种固定模式** — 标准模式简洁改写并澄清请求；专业模式根据任务复杂度建模，并在需要时补充执行与验收细节。
- **场景路由** — `professional` 档既可以自行判定场景（`auto`），也可以锁定到八个场景之一（`coding`、`writing`、`research`、`data`、`creative`、`business`、`agent`、`general`）。`coding` 会额外启用实现子场景规则。
- **输出语言** — 跟随草稿语言，或固定为中文 / 英文。

**不离开输入栏就能撤销**

- **按钮变成撤销** — 改写完成后同一个按钮切换为撤销图标，点击一次原样恢复优化前的草稿，图标随即变回星标。
- **手动编辑即失效** — 你一旦自己改动草稿，撤销状态就被丢弃，因此按钮绝不会用它没写过的文本覆盖你的编辑。
- **按键仍归宿主** — 插件不再注册 `Ctrl+Z` / `Ctrl+Y` 绑定，输入栏内的撤销与重做保持宿主编辑器自身行为。

**写作过程中的感知**

- **余额与价格卡片** — 挂在 `sidebar.footer.action`：当前余额、带倒计时的峰谷时段标签，以及该时段下 Flash 与 V4 Pro 的缓存命中输入价。每 60 秒轮询一次，在窗口获得焦点或切回标签页时刷新，拉取失败时保留上一份快照并标记为 *stale* 而不是弹出错误；在折叠边栏中收敛为带状态点的钱包图标。
- **草稿计量** — 挂在 `conversation.input.left`：实时草稿的估算 token 数、按当前时段折算的费用，以及三个点状指示，用于在本地检查目标 / 约束 / 验收。不使用 tokenizer，不调用模型，不发起网络请求。
- **项目模板** — 从 `.agents/prompts/*.md` 读取；单独输入 `/tpl:<name>` 并回车会插入骨架而不发送，固定某个模板后它还会作为结构参考传给优化器。

| 要求 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| dsh | `>=0.2.1-rc.5`（`package.json` 中的 `engines.dsh`） |
| 客户端 bundle | Web 客户端（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app`）。纯 host 的 profile 会载入插件但没有 UI。 |
| 默认模型 | `/be-optimize` 通过 `ctx.llm` 调用当前选中的模型；未选中时返回「没有可用模型，请先配置模型」。 |
| 可选服务 | `fs` 与 `webServer`。两者都是探测而非强注入——缺失时只是不注册模板路由。 |
| Node / pnpm | 随 DSH 运行时自带。插件自身只有一个运行时依赖 `@deepseek-ai/schemastery`。 |
包名为 `@unknowssq/better-experience`，已按 npm 发布要求准备就绪，但 `0.1.0` 尚未上架，因此目前验证过的装法是链接本地检出。下面两种方式都给出：一旦 `0.1.0` 发布，`add` 只需包名，只有要改源码时才需要本地检出。

`0.1.0` 上架后，安装就是这两行：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add @unknowssq/better-experience
dsh --profile web --no-open
```

`dsh plugin add` 一步写两处：`dependencies` 得到该包，`dsh.profile.bundles` 得到包名。启动时**不要**带 `--patch`——原因见 [profile 如何载入本插件](#profile-如何载入本插件)。

当你正在修改源码、想跑自己这版而不是已发布版本时：

```powershell
cd <本检出的路径>
pnpm install
dsh plugin --profile web add "@unknowssq/better-experience@link:<本检出的路径>"
dsh --profile web --no-open

桌面应用独占自己的 profile：`dsh --profile desktop --dump-config` 会以 `error: profile "desktop" is managed exclusively by the Electron application` 退出，因此没有 CLI 启动或检查路径。受支持的入口是应用自带的插件管理界面。在 rc.5 上，CLI 仍可完成安装本身：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add @unknowssq/better-experience
```

然后**完全退出应用并重新打开**。`bundles` 属于启动配置；应用内的插件刷新只会重挂已在名册里的插件。

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web list
```

侧边栏应出现 **Better Experience** 条目，输入区应出现优化按钮与草稿计量。若 host 已载入但 UI 缺失，说明包不在 `bundles` 中——见[插件不加载时的排查](#插件不加载时的排查)表格。

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web remove @unknowssq/better-experience
```

这会移除依赖项与 `bundles` 条目。写入 `cordis.patch.yml` 的各 profile 设置会保留，需要手动删除。

1. 用上面的命令安装并启动 web profile。
2. 打开 DSH 打印出的 URL，然后在侧边栏点开 **Better Experience**。
3. 随手写一段草稿，例如「把这段话改得更自然。」，按星标按钮。只有重写后的提示词被写回输入栏，按钮随之变成撤销图标，点击一次即可还原草稿。不按这个按钮，草稿不会被任何流程改写。
每个字段都是 `volatile()`：修改后立即生效，无需重启 host。取值保存在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 中 `- id: better-experience` 之下。

| 字段 | 类型 | 默认值 | 含义 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | boolean | `true` | 挂载优化按钮、草稿计量与设置项。关闭会卸载按钮，因此不会有任何流程改写草稿。 |
| `template` | string | `""` | `.agents/prompts/<name>.md` 下参考模板的名称。留空则不注入 few-shot 块。 |
| `balanceEnabled` | boolean | `true` | 在侧边栏底部显示余额与分时价格卡片，包含折叠态图标。 |
| `mode` | `standard` \| `professional` | `standard` | 任务建模深度：简洁的语义清理，或考虑复杂度、按场景自适应的结构。 |
| `scene` | `auto` \| 八个场景 | `auto` | 仅在 `professional` 档使用；`auto` 让模型先判定场景。 |
| `language` | `auto` \| `zh` \| `en` | `auto` | 优化后提示词及其元数据的输出语言。 |

按发送按钮旁的星标按钮。该请求是一次不带工具的普通模型调用：草稿被包进不可信的 `<draft>` 数据中，system prompt 按如下方式拼装

```text
CORE_RULES + MODE_POLICY[mode]
+ SCENE_POLICY[scene] (仅在锁定场景时) + CODING_IMPLEMENTATION_POLICY (仅 coding)
+ LANGUAGE_RULE[language] + 模板块 (仅在固定模板时) + OUTPUT_CONTRACT
```

模型必须以结构化 JSON 作答（`optimized_prompt`、`intent`、`is_existing_project`、场景路由、`changes`、`assumptions`、`missing_information`）。解析失败会先做一次修复重试，之后才原样使用文本。
优化完成后，输入栏按钮由星标变为撤销图标。点击一次即恢复优化前的原文并清空撤销状态，按钮回到优化动作。手动编辑草稿同样会清空它。插件不绑定撤销 / 重做快捷键：输入栏里的 `Ctrl+Z` 仍由宿主编辑器的撤销栈负责。

余额来自宿主 DeepSeek 账户服务的 `remote.account.getBalance`——插件自己没有计费 API。价格是**静态参考数值**，抄自官方定价页（2026-09-10 更新）并保存在 `BILLING` 常量中，任何情况下都不作为实时账单数据呈现。高峰时段为北京时间周一至周五 09:00–12:00 与 14:00–18:00，其余为空闲时段、按半价计，周末全天为空闲时段。

在 `.agents/prompts/` 下新建 markdown 文件：

```markdown
---
title: 代码评审
scene: coding
vars: lang, focus
---

……
```

`title`、`scene`、`vars` 均可省略；未知的 `scene` 会退化为 `auto`。模板会出现在「参考模板」选择器中，`/tpl:代码评审` 插入正文，`insert` / `adopted` 计数累积在 `.agents/prompts/.usage.json`。

| 界面 | 名称 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| Host 命令 | `/be-optimize` | `recordInput: false`。返回 `{ kind: 'success', text }`，其中 `text` 是 `{"__be":1,"prompt":…,"meta":…}` 信封；客户端只应用 `prompt`。 |
| HTTP 路由 | `GET /plugins/better-experience/templates` | 模板列表。仅在 `webServer` 与 `fs` 都存在时注册。 |
| HTTP 路由 | `POST /plugins/better-experience/templates/usage` | 记录 `insert` / `adopted` 计数。注册条件同上。 |

客户端侧注册，供参考：

| Slot | Id | 渲染内容 |
|---|---|---|
| `conversation.input.activity` | `better-experience-optimize` | 优化按钮，改写后变为撤销 |
| `conversation.input.left` | `better-experience-draft-meter` | token / 费用计量与三点检查 |
| `sidebar.panellist` | `better-experience` | 打开面板的侧边栏条目 |
| `sidebar.footer.action` | `better-experience-balance` | 余额卡片 |
| `main` | `better-experience` | 设置面板内容 |
Host `inject`：`commands`、`llm`、`agentDefaultModel`。Client `inject`：`slots`、`locale`、`remote`、`remote.commands`、`remote.account`、`configForms`、`shortcuts`。
Web 与桌面端启动的是同一份 host 代码、同一个 Web 客户端 bundle，但它们从不同位置解析本插件。三条事实几乎覆盖所有「插件没有显示出来」的情况：

1. **只有 bundle 能到达浏览器。** 客户端脚本名册由 `dsh.profile.bundles` 中各个包的 patch 文件推导；每一行启用、且所属包声明了 `dsh.client.platform === 'web'` 的条目会成为注入行（`packages/test-support/client-runtime/src/assembly/bundle-roster.ts`）。profile 自己的 `cordis.patch.yml` 不参与该名册，因此只写在那里的插入只会载入 host 一半、UI 为空。
2. **`cordis.patch.yml` 只做覆盖，不做安装。** 包进入 `bundles` 之后，profile patch 里的 `- id: better-experience` 行叠加在 bundle 的 insert 之上。各 profile 的取值就放在这里。
3. **`--patch` 是第三层，且不能与 bundle 安装同时使用。** 它会重新 insert 同一个 id，于是合成后的树里出现两个 `better-experience` 条目，靠后、更单薄的那个获胜——保存过的设置点完看起来又弹回去。

| 症状 | 成因 |
|---|---|
| `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND: Cannot find package '@unknowssq/better-experience'` | `dependencies` 里没有该包 |
| `patch: entry "better-experience" not found` | profile patch 覆盖了一个没有任何 bundle 插入的 id |
| `--dump-config` 里出现两个 `better-experience` 条目；点选后选择器回弹 | bundle 安装与 `--patch` 同时使用 |
| Host 命令可用，但侧边栏 / 设置 UI 缺失 | 包只写在 `cordis.patch.yml`，从未进入 `bundles` |
| 改过 patch 后桌面端 UI 缺失 | 改 `bundles` 后没有重启应用 |

`client.js` 是一个 bundle：dsh 通过 `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory(require) })` 载入第三方客户端，其中 `require()` 解析的是宿主模块注册表而非文件系统。因此模块化来自文件内的分段——Constants → Locale → 纯逻辑 → Hooks → UI 组件 → 样式 → `apply`——并遵循单向依赖规则，用命名的 CSS 常量取代独立文件。

完整分区、依赖规则与样式生命周期：`docs/plugin-architecture.md`，该文档随开发检出保留，不在发布包内。

改动前值得了解的设计约束：

- **只用 token。** 所有颜色来自宿主设计变量（`--dsw-alias-*`、`--dsw-radius-*`、`--dsw-shadow-*`）；不重设任何宿主选择器，不硬编码颜色。`apply` 中创建一个 `<style>` 元素，由其清理函数移除。
- **左对齐面板。** `.be-settings` 使用 `margin:0` 与 `max-width:560px`，使标题、卡片与行共享同一条左边缘。
- **自适应宽度底栏卡片。** `.be-foot-card` 为 `width:fit-content`，上限 `max-width:calc(100% - 8px)`；左列 `flex:0 1 auto; min-width:0`，因此只有余额会被省略号截断，价格列从不收缩。

```powershell
node --check index.js
node --check client.js
```

本包没有构建步骤，也没有测试运行器。源码在载入时只读一次，因此修改 `index.js` 或 `client.js` 后需要重启 host；配置项是 `volatile()`，实时生效。
评审 Standard / Professional 策略改动时使用这些草稿。每个都要在两种模式下各跑一遍；做转换检查时，把一种模式的输出再喂回另一种模式。按「要求的交付物」与「主要工作类型」判断，而不是按主题关键词。这些是评审用例，不是自动化断言。

| 用例 | 草稿 / 转换 | 期望行为 |
|---|---|---|
| 简单请求 | “把这段话改得更自然。” | 两种模式都保持提示词简洁；Professional 不会平白添加角色、工作流或验收章节。 |
| 既有项目，单点修复 | “修复设置页切换主题后下拉框仍是浅色的问题。” | 保留直接的修复请求；可以引导查看仓库并做一次聚焦检查，但不搭多阶段脚手架。 |
| 显式约束 | “给报表加导出功能，只改报表模块，不增加依赖，保留现有 CSV 格式。” | 所有约束在双向模式转换中都存活，且只出现一次。 |
| 多任务实现 | “增加批量导入、失败重试和导入记录页，并补上必要测试。” | Professional 把三项交付物分开，并给出有意义的验收检查；不逐段重复同样的指导。 |
| 缺失但可查的细节 | “把用户列表加分页。” | 不要一上来就问页大小或接口形状；引导去查既有约定。 |
| 关键歧义 | “清理生产环境里不需要的数据。” | 提出聚焦的澄清问题；绝不臆造删除范围或授权。 |
| 代码与写作混合 | “修复帮助中心 Markdown 页面的代码示例，再润色周边说明。” | 主场景：coding；次场景：writing。 |
| 研究类词汇，写作类产出 | “把我提供的访谈摘录整理成一篇清晰的总结，不要查外部资料。” | 主场景：writing；没有 research 次场景。 |

用同一段草稿复核两种模式：“优化 dsh 插件的 README.md，专业重构结构，参考官方和社区插件示例，并将项目推送至 GitHub，使插件具备被收录和官方推荐载入的条件。”

| 模式 | 期望行为 |
|---|---|
| Standard | 简洁重写，保留任务范围并说清目标；最多补一项确实有助于理解的信息，不展开通用工作流。 |
| Professional | 建模多项任务：检查项目、通过一手来源核对官方要求、区分官方规则与社区惯例、重构并检查 README，再安全推送限定范围的改动。标出未核实的条件；目标含糊、远端分歧或权限不足时停止推送。不得暗示文档重构即可保证官方收录。 |

检查两种输出是否在任务建模深度上有可见区别，同时保留 README 修改与 GitHub 推送目标。不安全或含糊的 Git 操作必须停止，不得强制推送、改动远程或丢弃无关工作。
按维度打 0–2 分（失败 / 部分达成 / 良好），把主场景准确率与次场景的精确率、召回率分开统计。外部收录类任务另评：一手来源核实、官方规则与社区惯例的区分、未知标准是否标注为未核实。发布类任务另评：目标核实与安全中止行为。丢失硬约束或改变被要求的动作属于阻断性失败，与总分无关。

- **草稿文本**会发送到你选定的模型，重写后的文本通过宿主的草稿 API 写回输入框。
- **模型调用**消耗你的 token。每次优化是一次不带工具的模型调用，插件其余部分不会调用模型。
- **模板**从会话工作区的 `.agents/prompts` 读取，计数写入 `.agents/prompts/.usage.json`。
- **余额**通过 `remote.account.getBalance` 读取；价格是随插件发布的常量。
- **无遥测**，无分析端点，除你配置的模型提供方与账户服务外没有其他网络请求。
